description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/Sources/GoOut. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the GET go out operation in source/supplier reading. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the go out operation for source/supplier reading. Input: [FromQuery] sourceUrl: string. [FromQuery] isoCountry: int?. [FromQuery] channelListingId: int?. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the go out operation. Search terms: sources goout. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

title: Get Sources Goout
